candidates.content_text:
The Opportunity
Our client who is a first class civil engineering consultancy who is seeking a Graduate Civil Engineer to join their experienced Cairns-based engineering team.
This is an opportunity to apply your technical skills to projects that have a genuine impact, from roads that connect communities and drainage systems that protect property, through to bridges, culverts, water infrastructure and land development projects.
This consultancy provides civil engineering and project management services across government, private development, infrastructure and regional projects throughout Far North Queensland and beyond. Their project portfolio includes roads and drainage, water and wastewater infrastructure, subdivisions, bridge and crossing works, airports and major infrastructure projects.
The Role
You will be a hands-on member of the engineering team, contributing to the planning, design and delivery of a broad range of civil infrastructure projects.
This is more than producing drawings and technical reports. You will see projects progress from concept and design through to construction and completion, working alongside experienced engineers, clients, contractors and other stakeholders.
Your responsibilities will include:
- Developing practical and cost-effective civil infrastructure designs
- Supporting road, drainage, stormwater, water and land development projects
- Preparing technical drawings, documentation and engineering reports
- Assisting with project delivery and undertaking site inspections
- Monitoring construction outcomes, quality and project requirements
- Identifying technical issues and developing practical solutions
- Supporting approvals, compliance and stakeholder requirements
- Liaising professionally with clients, contractors and project stakeholders
- Working closely with senior engineers while developing your technical capability
About You
You will be a motivated Civil Engineer who enjoys civil design, practical problem solving and wants exposure to a diverse range of projects.
You will ideally have:
- Degree qualification in Civil Engineering
- Practical experience in civil design is a must
- Exposure to roads, drainage, stormwater, water, subdivisions or similar projects
- Strong technical and problem-solving skills
- Good attention to detail and an ability to manage competing priorities
- Clear written and verbal communication skills
- A practical approach to engineering and project delivery
- Current driver's licence and willingness to attend project sites
This role could suit an early-career Civil Engineer looking to build broader consulting experience, or an Engineer with several years of experience seeking greater project variety and responsibility.
Why Join This Engineering Consultancy?
They offer the opportunity to work alongside experienced Civil Engineers and project professionals on projects across both metropolitan and regional environments. The business places a strong emphasis on professional development, practical experience, integrity and delivering quality outcomes for its clients.
Job Offer
- $75,000 - $85,000 + super, negotiable based on experience
- Relocation assistance available
- Diverse civil projects from concept and design through to construction
- Exposure to roads, drainage, water, infrastructure and land development
- Hands-on project and site experience
- Mentoring from experienced senior engineers
- Ongoing training and professional development
- Opportunity to contribute ideas and influence project outcomes
- Supportive and collaborative team environment
- Long-term career stability and genuine project variety
How To Apply
To build your career with a company that values quality engineering, practical solutions and the work you deliver, please click Apply and please include any civil design experience you have undertaken in your application.
About Us
With Head Office in Cairns and offices in Townsville and Brisbane. We specialise in professional, administration, engineering and industrial recruitment, permanent and temporary placements for both commercial and government enterprise. We are proud to connect great people with meaningful careers.

candidates.content_text:
City of Armadale
Armadale, Perth WA
Engineering – Civil/Structural Engineering 
$102,000–$117,000 per annum plus superannuation
Shape a growing City’s infrastructure. Plan capital projects through design, costing and approvals, with WFH and flexi-time for a 9-day fortnight.
 -  Shape infrastructure projects across asset renewal, upgrades and growth.
 -  Flexible working with WFH and accrued flexi-time towards a 9-day fortnight.
 -  Superannuation up to 15%, subject to conditions, plus free gym membership.
 Help shape the projects that shape our City
Good infrastructure starts with good decisions. Understanding what is needed, testing the options and resolving the detail before construction begins.
At the City of Armadale, you’ll help make those decisions. As one of Western Australia’s fastest-growing local governments, we’re planning new infrastructure while improving and renewing the assets our community already relies on.
We’re looking for a Project Planning Engineer who brings practical judgement, asks good questions and takes pride in preparing projects properly.
If you’re enjoying your current role but would welcome the opportunity to influence a growing City’s infrastructure, this could be your next move.
Why Armadale?
Our Strategic Community Plan sets a clear direction: facilities that meet community needs, better public places, and infrastructure that is functional, inclusive and sustainable.
You’ll help turn those priorities into practical projects, balancing technical requirements, cost, risk and long-term asset performance. Across renewal, upgrade and growth projects, you’ll tackle varied challenges and see how your work contributes to the community.
You’ll also have flexibility in how you work, including working from home and the ability to accrue flexi-time to work a nine-day fortnight, with arrangements agreed around role and team requirements.
Your role
Working in our Asset Planning team, reporting to the Project Planning Lead, you’ll progress identified infrastructure priorities into well-defined, costed and approved capital projects ready for delivery.
Starting with Project Initiation Documents developed by Strategic Asset Management, you’ll coordinate investigations and detailed designs, refine cost estimates and progress the approvals needed for capital works program entry.
You’ll work with engineering and landscape design specialists, consultants, asset operators and delivery teams to:
 - Develop clear project scopes, specifications and budget requirements.
 - Coordinate investigations, technical advice and detailed design activities.
 - Prepare and refine cost estimates, checking assumptions, contingencies and constructability.
 - Progress approvals, utility clearances, statutory consents and other project requirements.
 - Prepare complete project packages for review under the City’s Project Management Framework.
 - Resolve risks and gaps early, considering procurement, construction sequencing and handover requirements.
Your work will help the City make informed investment decisions and give delivery teams confidence in each project’s scope, cost and readiness.
What you’ll bring
You know what it takes to prepare an infrastructure project for delivery. You can work through technical detail, challenge assumptions constructively and bring the right people together to resolve issues.
We’re looking for:
 - Tertiary qualifications in Civil Engineering, Project Management, Construction Management or a closely related discipline**, or equivalent demonstrated experience in project planning and infrastructure development.
 - Experience planning civil infrastructure or construction projects.
 - Sound knowledge of cost estimation, contingency allowances and key cost drivers.
 - The ability to coordinate technical input across disciplines and progress third-party approvals.
 - Familiarity with project management frameworks and project approval requirements.
Flexibility and benefits
 - Working-from-home arrangements and flexi-time, including the ability to accrue time towards a nine-day fortnight.
 - Superannuation contributions of up to 15%, subject to employee contributions and applicable conditions.
 - Free Armadale Fitness and Aquatic Centre membership**, including the gym, pools, sauna and group fitness classes.
 - Wellbeing activities throughout the year.
 - Novated leasing opportunities.
Our values—Care; Are Better, Together; Learn & Grow; and Seize Today, Shape Tomorrow—guide how we work. We listen, share knowledge and welcome people who bring ideas and take responsibility for their work.
Interested? Let’s talk
You don’t need to be actively looking for a new job to explore this opportunity.
For an initial confidential conversation, contact People Services on 9394 5189 or hr@armadale.wa.gov.au. 
Ready to apply? Submit your CV and a brief cover letter through the application link, outlining your relevant experience and interest in the role.
We review applications as they are received and may close the advertisement early.
*The City of Armadale welcomes applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, people with disability, people from culturally diverse backgrounds and people of all genders and identities.*
*We are committed to child safety and recruitment practices that support a safe and inclusive community.*

candidates.content_text:
ACCIONA is a global company, leading in the development of regenerative infrastructure that creates a positive impact on society. Our workforce consists of more than 65,000 professionals, present in more than 40 countries across the five continents, all contributing to our mission to design a better planet. Are you a passionate individual who wants to make a difference, promote sustainable development, and find solutions to the biggest global challenges, including climate change, overpopulation, and water scarcity? Come and join us in building the infrastructure our planet needs to achieve a sustainable future.
ACEREZ, a partnership of ACCIONA, COBRA and Endeavour Energy, has been appointed network operator by EnergyCo to design, build, finance, operate and maintain the Central-West Orana Renewable Energy Zone (REZ) transmission network. The ACCIONA COBRA Joint Venture (ACJV), the design and construct (D&C) consortium, will design and build the Central-West Orana REZ transmission project.
The Central-West Orana Renewable Energy Zone (REZ) Transmission Project will build new high-capacity transmission lines, energy hubs and supporting infrastructure to transfer power generated by solar and wind projects to electricity consumers. The new infrastructure is expected to be operational by 2028 and will initially unlock up to 4.5 gigawatts of new network capacity.
The project consists of 90km of 500kV overhead transmission lines and 150 km of 330kV transmission lines for generator connections, stretching from Elong Elong in the west through to Barigan Creek in the east, via an energy hub at Merotherie.
The Central-West Orana project is currently seeking a dedicated Site Engineer - Civil to share their expertise within our growing Energy Hubs and Substations Teams.
Key Responsibilities
- Ensure all quality and environmental aspects of the project are addressed to maintain effective operation and project delivery.
- Ensures non-conformances are recorded and corrective actions initiated as soon as practically possible.
- Completes all outstanding defects as required by the program.
- Prepares Inspection Test Reports and checklists that accurately reflect contract requirements.
- Provide support on planning the use of materials, resources, components or systems within the project, and construction practices and problems to ensure project success, value for money and best practice are achieved.
- Assist the Project Engineer with development of construction planning documents and monitor implementation.
- Maintain project schedule by monitoring project progress and coordinating activities.
- Assist with preparing project status reports and change orders.
- Assesses progress daily and prepares plan of works for daily cost planning meeting (if held)
- Responsible and accountable to ensure that the requirements of the Contract are being satisfied at work crew level.
- Coordinate resource allocation with the expectation that you would encourage effective teamwork and foster a positive attitude toward the achievement of organisational objectives.
- Tracks subcontractor resources daily and record accurately
- Prepares cost plan/resources for daily cost planning meeting.
Required Skills and Competencies
- Bachelor's degree (Engineering) Civil or Relevant Tertiary Education
- Experience constructing outdoor air insulated substations and substations at 220kV or above
- Tier 1 Contractor experience is preferred, on large scale projects
- Preferable 1 to 3 years post graduate experience in a construction / engineering environment
- Demonstrated ability to work effectively with others.
- Establish and steward overall delivery work plans.
- Ensuring all relevant regulatory requirements are satisfied.
- Competent in planning and organising work schedules.
- Working knowledge of HS&E requirements and implementation of same
- Clear communication - verbal and written
Site Engineer positions are bus in bus out, in camp style accommodation provided for 14 days onsite and 7 days off site, on a roster-based arrangement out of the Central West Orana Region, Merotherie.
This position is being delivered as part of a joint venture between two organisations. As such, your employment may be with either of the parent companies, and this will be confirmed during the recruitment process.
We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. If you believe you bring the capabilities to succeed in this role, we'd love to hear from you. We look forward to continuing to build our supportive workplace together.
For more information on how your personal data is managed, please refer to the privacy statements of each parent company:
Grupo Cobra: https://www.grupocobra.com/en/privacy-policy/
Acciona: Privacy Policy | ACCIONA | Business as unusual

Duffy Kennedy Constructions (DKC) is seeking an experienced and motivated Civil Engineering Draftsperson to join our team in Miranda, NSW. The successful candidate will work closely with our design and construction teams, contributing to the efficient delivery of residential, commercial and other building projects.
Key responsibilities
- Prepare and amend detailed civil and structural engineering drawings using AutoCAD, Revit or other relevant drafting software.
- Produce technical drawings for earthworks, drainage systems, foundations, reinforced concrete elements and other construction components.
- Interpret engineering calculations, design specifications and technical sketches to develop accurate construction drawings and documentation.
- Review and update drawings to reflect design changes, construction requirements and actual site conditions.
- Conduct site visits when required to verify construction details, identify discrepancies and assist with drawing revisions.
- Liaise with engineers, estimators, project managers and subcontractors to ensure drawings meet project requirements and relevant Australian Standards.
- Provide technical drafting support to construction teams and assist in resolving drawing-related issues during project execution.
- Maintain accurate drawing records, documentation and version control throughout the project lifecycle.
About you
- Relevant tertiary qualification in Civil Engineering, Engineering Drafting, Architectural Engineering or a related discipline.
- Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in civil or structural engineering drafting, preferably within the building construction industry.
- Proficiency in AutoCAD, Revit or similar drafting software.
- Sound understanding of civil and structural engineering principles, construction methods and technical drawing standards.
- Experience preparing detailed drawings for residential, commercial or multi-storey building projects will be highly regarded.
- Strong attention to detail, problem-solving abilities and organisational skills.
- Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineers, project managers and construction personnel.
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and respond efficiently to changing project requirements.
Benefits
- Competitive salary package commensurate with qualifications and experience.
- Full-time employment with an established construction company.
- Opportunities to work on a diverse range of residential and commercial construction projects.
- A collaborative working environment with experienced construction professionals.
- Opportunities for ongoing professional development and career progression.
About us
Duffy Kennedy Constructions is an established Sydney-based construction company delivering a diverse range of residential, commercial and other building projects. With extensive experience in the construction industry, we are committed to delivering high-quality projects through effective project management, technical expertise and close collaboration between our office and on-site teams. As our construction activities continue to develop, we are strengthening our internal technical capabilities to support efficient project delivery and maintain high standards across our operations.

Join a growing South Australian civil construction company and build your career across project engineering, construction delivery, estimating and commercial management. 
About Oakleigh Civil 
Oakleigh Civil is a South Australian civil construction company specialising in civil infrastructure and structural concrete projects. Our capabilities include formwork, reinforcement, concrete placement and excavation. 
We work with on major infrastructure projects across metropolitan and regional South Australia, as well as interstate. 
Our work spans water infrastructure, defence, renewable energy, roads, mining and electrical infrastructure. 
Our experienced team takes a practical approach to delivering projects safely and to a very high standard. We value strong client relationships and take pride in being a contractor our clients can rely on.
About the role 
We are seeking a motivated Site / Project Engineer with at least three years’ construction experience to join our growing team. 
Working closely with the Construction Manager, company management, site supervisors and clients, you will help plan, coordinate and deliver projects from tender stage through to completion.  
The role combines site-based project management, estimating and commercial responsibilities. Unlike a traditional site engineering role, you will have exposure to the full project lifecycle, including estimating, procurement, construction delivery, cost control, variations, progress claims and project close-out. 
The successful candidate will be expected to take ownership of assigned projects, identify issues early and work with the project team to develop practical solutions. 
This position suits someone who is looking to broaden their capabilities, take greater responsibility and develop their career within a growing civil construction business.
Key responsibilities 
- Plan and coordinate construction activities with site supervisors to meet project requirements and construction programs. 
- Take ownership of allocated projects from planning through to completion. 
- Maintain regular communication with clients regarding project progress, upcoming works and any issues requiring resolution. 
- Review drawings, specifications and scope documents, identify issues, discrepancies, risks and constructability issues. 
- Assist with estimating, quantity take-offs, quotations and tender submissions. 
- Prepare and maintain project schedules, budgets, forecasts and progress reports. 
- Monitor project costs, cost-to-complete and forecasts. 
- Prepare and track project costs, variations and progress claims. 
- Coordinate procurement of materials, subcontractors and suppliers in accordance with project requirements and programs. 
- Coordinate project quality requirements, including ITP’s, inspections, testing, NCR’s and handover documentation. 
- Maintain accurate project documentation, registers, correspondence and records. 
- Support site safety requirements and work with supervisors to ensure works are planned and delivered safely. 
- Provide practical engineering and constructability advice to site teams. 
- Build and maintain effective relationships with clients, contractors and suppliers. 
About you 
- A degree in Civil Engineering or a relevant engineering discipline. 
- At least three years’ experience as a Site or Project Engineer in construction. 
- Experience in civil infrastructure or structural concrete works; formwork, reinforcement and concrete placement experience will be highly regarded. 
- Ability to interpret construction drawings, specifications and technical requirements. 
- Understanding of construction programming, project cost control, quality assurance and WHS requirements. 
- Strong organisation, communication and problem-solving skills. 
- Experience with variations, progress claims and project documentation. 
- Ability to manage competing priorities across multiple projects. 
- A practical approach, initiative and willingness to work closely with site supervisors and site crews. 
- Ability to identify problems early and take ownership of finding practical solutions. 
- Willingness and ability to work away from home when required. 
- A genuine desire to develop your skills and progress your career within a growing construction business. 
Why Join Oakleigh Civil?
- Varied projects: Work on civil infrastructure and structural concrete projects in metropolitan and regional South Australia, as well as interstate. 
- Broader experience: Gain exposure to the full project lifecycle, including estimating, procurement, construction, commercial management and project close out. 
- Direct involvement: Work closely with Construction Manager, company management and experienced site teams with the opportunity to influence how projects are delivered. 
- Career development: Build your capabilities across project management, estimating and commercial management, with genuine pathway to increase responsibility as the company grows. 
- Make a Contribution: Bring your ideas and help improve the way we work that supports Oakleigh Civil’s continued growth. 
Apply now 
If you’re looking to take the next step in your engineering career with Oakleigh Civil, apply through SEEK with your CV and a brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience.

And definitely not feel like you’re just another number in a giant consultancy.
This is an opportunity to join J. Wyndham Prince, a highly respected civil engineering consultancy where subdivision work is the bread and butter, but the project exposure goes far beyond that.
You’ll be working across land development, stormwater and infrastructure projects, contributing to road upgrades, TfNSW-related works, and large-scale developments shaping communities across Greater Sydney.

Small enough for your contribution to matter.

You’ll work alongside experienced engineers and designers delivering practical, buildable outcomes across civil infrastructure and urban development projects.

Instead, you’ll be supported by strong senior people while continuing to grow your own technical capability and project exposure.
That said, there’s genuine long-term opportunity here for someone who wants to step into leadership down the track.

You might come from a consultancy background and already understand how to collaborate across engineers, designers, councils, contractors and project stakeholders.
Technically, you’re comfortable working within civil design software and understand how projects move from concept through to delivery.
But equally important is your attitude.
You’re accountable.
You communicate well.
You ask questions when you don’t know something.
You take direction onboard and genuinely want to improve.
You’re someone the team can rely on.
Your new organisation
J.Wyndham Prince has built a strong reputation across Greater Sydney for delivering high-quality civil engineering solutions across land development and infrastructure projects.
With expertise spanning subdivisions, stormwater management, infrastructure and urban development, they continue to deliver practical, technically strong outcomes for both private and government clients.
What sets them apart is the environment they’ve built internally.
The team is collaborative, approachable and growth-focused. People are trusted, supported and given genuine opportunity to develop their careers while contributing to meaningful projects shaping local communities.

If you have a CV, click ‘apply’ to be immediately considered.

LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/in/oliviajwild
Email: owild@rarekind.com.au
